Definition
[Focal point] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0306 ↗ appb-def-normal-bundle 1. Definition B.18\group local-comparison-geometry

If $l:\Sigma ^k\hookrightarrow \mathcal M^n$ is an immersion, a point $q\in \mathcal M^n$ is a focal point of $l(\Sigma ^k)$ if it is a critical value of the normal exponential map $\exp _{\mid N\Sigma ^k}$.
